title: testPointers kept on the view state (TAC-4136)
description: renderModelToPage additively returns the resolved testPointers map alongside the walked tree so the server state carries it and GET /coverage.json composes computeCoverage(tree, { strict: true, scopeId, testPointers: state.testPointers }) (AC-208-3). The CLI resolves pointers the same way via resolveTestPointers; the viewer and CLI share one map per walk.
